frozen_derivatives.skeleton_only: Public-compatible OpenCV-fallback decode of the exact conditioning segment after OpenCV INTER_LINEAR resize; intended-motion evidence only.
frozen_derivatives.visible_skeleton_review: Generated OSCAR pixels with only detected conditioning-annotation pixels alpha blended at 0.85; review composite, not native OSCAR output.
frozen_derivatives.skeleton_region_occluded_scene: Generated OSCAR pixels under the dilated conditioning mask replaced with RGB black; occlusion diagnostic, not inpainting.
frozen_derivatives.binary_occlusion_mask: The exact dilated mask used by the occlusion diagnostic.

mask_contract.input: decoded RGB uint8 exact skeleton-conditioning frames
mask_contract.dilation: OpenCV elliptical kernel, radius 7 pixels, one iteration
mask_contract.selection_basis: Label-free conditioning-only coverage audit; no generated outcome or physical label was used to choose thresholds.
